_comment: Tracxn API registry built from the 'TracxnAPI Playground' Postman collection (v2.2 + v3.0 Key Metrics). Playground and production share identical paths; production simply drops the '/playground' segment. Header: accessToken. Tokens are environment-specific.

token_pages.production: Data Solutions > API & Developer Tools > Production > API Token (needs an API subscription)

company_search.description: Name -> top 10 {id, name, domain}. companyName is mandatory, one value only.

companies.description: Full company profile: sectors, description, funding, investors, valuation, revenue, employees, ratings, scores, acquisitions, IPO, part-of, board, news, apps, contacts.

transactions.description: Funding rounds (filter by company domain / companiesId): amount, date, category, investors, facilitators, post-money valuation.

acquisitions.description: M&A deals: as target (domain) or as acquirer (acquirerListDomain): amounts, share price, valuation, sellers, notable people, cap table.

investors.description: Investor profiles filtered by portfolio company domain: type, location, feeds, investment score, social profiles.

company_metrics.description: v3.0 Key Metrics aggregation (count / sum / avg / median funding or employees), bucketed by stage, sector or geography.

competitors.description: Companies Tracxn tags as competitors of the target

subsidiaries.description: Companies that are part of the target

customers.description: Companies for which the target is a vendor

error_codes.401: Authentication issue: token missing or invalid
error_codes.403: Unauthorized: token expired, wrong environment, or access denied
error_codes.900: Credit limit exceeded: contact Tracxn to renew
